prediction.raw: 1. This expectation is reasonable because bike helmets are designed to absorb and distribute the impact of a fall, reducing the force of the blow to the head. They are a crucial safety device that can help prevent or minimize head injuries, including skull fractures and brain damage. While no helmet can guarantee 100% protection, a properly fitted and certified helmet can significantly reduce the risk of head injury in the event of a crash or fall. Therefore, it is justified to expect that a bike helmet will help stop or reduce the impact of the head hitting the ground.
